title: Cisco’s AI-Driven Profit Jump; PPI Ahead – What’s Moving Markets: Dow Jones, S&P, Nasdaq, Wall Street Futures
excerpt: U. S. stock futures moved modestly higher on Thursday as investors looked ahead to another important inflation reading while assessing a fresh round of techn...
content_html:
Fiona Craig

Thu, August 13, 2026 at 2:19 AM PDT 5 min read

U.S. stock futures moved modestly higher on Thursday as investors looked ahead to another important inflation reading while assessing a fresh round of technology earnings. Cisco Systems (NASDAQ:CSCO) slipped in after-hours trading despite posting strong results fuelled by artificial intelligence demand, while semiconductor equipment maker Applied Materials (NASDAQ:AMAT) is scheduled to report after the closing bell. Geopolitical uncertainty also remains firmly in focus as the U.S. and Iran offer competing claims over control of the Strait of Hormuz amid stalled negotiations over reopening the strategically important waterway.

U.S. stock futures edge higher

Futures tracking Wall Street's major indices were slightly positive on Thursday as markets continued to digest July's inflation figures and recent technology-sector earnings.

By 02:58 ET (06:58 GMT), Dow futures were up 26 points, or 0.1%, while S&P 500 futures gained 6 points, also 0.1%. Nasdaq 100 futures advanced 29 points, equivalent to a 0.1% rise.

Wednesday's regular session produced a mixed performance across the major U.S. averages. The S&P 500 and technology-focused Nasdaq Composite finished higher, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average recorded a marginal decline.

Investor attention centred on data showing that annual U.S. consumer inflation slowed slightly last month, broadly matching forecasts, although the overall rate remained elevated. The figures strengthened expectations that the Federal Reserve will leave interest rates unchanged at its September meeting rather than raise borrowing costs further to tackle inflation.

Treasury yields moved lower following the inflation release, while the U.S. dollar weakened against a basket of major currencies.

Cisco profit climbs sharply on AI demand

Cisco Systems shares moved lower in extended trading on Wednesday despite the networking equipment company delivering a strong set of quarterly figures.

Analysts cited by Reuters noted that investor expectations had become particularly demanding ahead of the results. Cisco shares have climbed more than 60% this year as the company benefits from surging demand for networking equipment required to support artificial intelligence infrastructure.

Chief Executive Chuck Robbins told the Wall Street Journal that Cisco had not experienced such broad-based demand across its portfolio for three decades. The company has secured billions of dollars in orders from major technology groups that are investing heavily in expanding their AI capabilities.

美国股指期货周四小幅走高，投资者在评估新一轮科技股盈利的同时，期待另一个重要的通胀数据。 尽管在人工智能需求的推动下公布了强劲业绩，但思科系统公司（纳斯达克股票代码：CSCO）在盘后交易中仍下跌，而半导体设备制造商应用材料公司（纳斯达克股票代码：AMAT）计划在收盘后发布报告。 由于美国和伊朗在重新开放霍尔木兹海峡的谈判陷入僵局之际，对霍尔木兹海峡的控制权提出了相互竞争的要求，地缘政治的不确定性也仍然是人们关注的焦点。

美国股指期货小幅走高

由于市场继续消化 7 月份的通胀数据和近期科技行业的盈利，追踪华尔街主要股指的期货周四小幅上涨。

截至东部时间 02:58（格林威治标准时间 06:58），道指期货上涨 26 点，即 0.1%，而标准普尔 500 指数期货上涨 6 点，即 0.1%。 纳斯达克100指数期货上涨29点，相当于上涨0.1%。

周三的常规交易中，美国主要股指的表现好坏参半。 标准普尔 500 指数和以科技股为主的纳斯达克综合指数收高，而道琼斯工业平均指数则小幅下跌。

投资者的注意力集中在数据上，该数据显示上个月美国消费者通胀率略有放缓，与预期基本相符，但总体通胀率仍处于高位。 这些数据强化了美联储将在 9 月会议上维持利率不变，而不是进一步提高借贷成本以应对通胀的预期。

通胀释放后，美国国债收益率走低，而美元兑一篮子主要货币走弱。

思科利润因人工智能需求大幅攀升

尽管网络设备公司思科系统公司公布了强劲的季度数据，但其股价在周三的盘后交易中仍走低。

路透社援引分析师的话说，在结果公布之前，投资者的预期变得特别苛刻。 思科股价今年已上涨超过 60%，受益于支持人工智能基础设施所需的网络设备需求激增。

首席执行官查克·罗宾斯 (Chuck Robbins) 告诉《华尔街日报》，思科三十年来从未在其产品组合中经历过如此广泛的需求。 该公司已从各大科技集团获得了数十亿美元的订单，这些集团正在大力投资扩大其人工智能能力。
